title: Give OLY-B-D2-02 a mechanism: site accessibility, tracks, learning path
summary: Extend the explainer site generator (xtask/src/site.rs) so every page has a skip link, a core/expert track switch, a learning-path list, a reduced-motion rule and focus styles, on top of the existing viewport and dark mode. Then point OLY-B-D2-02 in docs/spec.toml at that code, with a measure ending `status: not shown` and the test that shows it.

defaults_applied.how: New test plus cargo test, clippy, fmt criteria.
Test asserts rendered page output, not just wiring.
One focused change in site.rs and spec.toml.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read xtask/src/site.rs: finish() builds the page wrapper with viewport meta; the CSS const (lines ~893-911) has prefers-color-scheme dark and a max-width:40rem rule but no reduced-motion, focus, skip link, tracks or learning path; tests at ~1608 assert viewport and prefers-color-scheme. Entry point is site::build -> render -> finish. The site is in xtask, not crates/; docs/spec.toml mechanisms cite paths like crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs. No record or data file is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not involved.
Existing code: extends xtask/src/site.rs (CSS, finish, render) and docs/design/explainer-site.md; reuses existing page tests.

Audience: the site's readers and the verifier checking the page output; goal is a page that visibly offers the listed features. 'Dark and light modes' is satisfied by the existing prefers-color-scheme plus color-scheme; a manual toggle is optional and not required.
The track control is CSS/HTML only (no JavaScript) to keep the static page simple; core is default and expert sections are shown via a checkbox or details element.
No governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) need changing.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-B-D2-02 has mechanism naming xtask/src/site.rs (a file that exists), owner Athena, and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the test, replacing mechanism = "none".

xtask/src/site.rs page wrapper and CSS contain: a skip link to main content, a core/expert track control with expert content marked, a learning-path ordered list of sections, an `@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)` rule, a `:focus-visible` style, and keep the viewport meta and prefers-color-scheme rules.

A new unit test in xtask/src/site.rs renders the real study page and asserts each feature above; run `cargo test -p xtask site`. The test fails when the new markup/CSS is removed (it asserts on strings the old page lacks) and passes with it.
Existing site tests still pass: `cargo test` passes.
`cargo clippy --all-targets` is clean and `cargo fmt --check` passes.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change.

out_of_scope: Client-side JavaScript or a build toolchain for the site
